d_ml_015.normalized_query: हैदराबाद के ऑर्डर के लिए औसत डिलीवरी देरी कितने घंटे की है?
d_ml_015.executed_sql:
SELECT 
    AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (e.occurred_at - o.placed_at)) / 3600) AS avg_delivery_delay_hours
FROM 
    orders o
JOIN 
    locations l ON o.ship_to_location_id = l.location_id
JOIN 
    fulfillments f ON o.order_id = f.order_id
JOIN 
    delivery_events e ON f.fulfillment_id = e.fulfillment_id AND e.event_type = 'DELIVERED'
WHERE 
    l.city_local = 'हैदराबाद';

d_ml_016.normalized_query: पुणे के ऑर्डर के लिए औसत डिलीवरी देरी कितने घंटे की है?
d_ml_016.executed_sql:
SELECT 
    (MAX(e.occurred_at) - MIN(f.promised_at))::interval / COUNT(DISTINCT f.order_id) AS avg_delivery_delay_hours
FROM 
    fulfillments f
JOIN 
    delivery_events e ON f.fulfillment_id = e.fulfillment_id
JOIN 
    orders o ON f.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN 
    locations l ON o.ship_to_location_id = l.location_id
WHERE 
    l.city_local = 'पुणे';
